name: Baseten GPU instances (dedicated, inference-shaped)
region: published rates are for Baseten's own regions; other countries are contact-sales
notes: The H100 rate of $6.50/GPU-hour is unremarkable - it sits above Runpod ($3.49) and Lambda ($3.99) and just under AWS p5 ($6.88) - so the honest read is that Baseten is NOT the cheapest bare H100 in this slice, and I am recording it because it is better sourced on some axes rather than cheaper. Two things it does better. First, H100 MIG 40GB at $3.75/hr: a 40GB slice of an H100 at under 60% of the full-part price is the cheapest credible way to get Hopper-class compute for a model that fits in 40GB, and no other provider in this slice publishes an MIG price at all. Second, and more architecturally interesting, 'You can deploy Baseten on your own infrastructure' - so Baseten's runtime on your own cloud commitments is an alternative to renting their fleet at their rate, which inverts the usual neocloud trade. Baseten does not charge for idle time and bills only while your model is deploying, scaling or predicting. Volume discounts exist but are Pro/Enterprise and negotiated, not published. Other regions are contact-sales. SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA certified.
